The machine produces only four side seal pouches. The number of tracks will depend on the width of the pouches, as maximum roll width is 1200mm. The laminate roll is drawn by the heat resistant silicon rubber pull rollers over other aluminum alloy rollers. The Pull rubber rollers are driven through a Servo motor. The system in turn is controlled automatically by the P.L.C in relation to photocell sensing of registration mark on the film. Photocell is used to sense the registration mark on the laminate film in order to keep the length of each pouch within the limits during each stroke of the machine. Photocell senses length in between registration marks on the film. The machine is equipped with an 14.2 Nm servo motor with a gear box 1:25 ratio for filling and 8.36 Nm servo motor with a gear box 1:20 ratio for horizontal and vertical sealing and 4.74Nm servo motor for pulling and 4.74Nm servo motor for value movement. The whole machine operation are controlled through a PLC (Programming Logic Controller) having 48/72 IO (input/output) capacity generally Allen Bradley” make is used. --- --- a) a GCG IS SIS SSIS bd eG SG EG I Vd IS SIG dG dG ddd bd 05 06 S Shubham Packo SPM 1200L PACK WITH CONFIDENCE! This assembly is used to maintain the laminate tension over the laminate path and to avoid the laminate from the reel shaft .Whenever the unwinding needs more power t pull the laminate from the reel shaft according to the machine speed. This assemble contains a dancing roller, rack and pinion assembly and two limit switches one at the top and the other at the bottom end of the rack. This arrangement operates the unwinding motor which is mounted in the unwinding assembly. 12.2.3.1 Lower Limit Switch (No) In normal position this limit switch gets NO connection and when the dancing roller pushes the lower limit switch downwards the electrical connection of the limit switch becomes NC (NORMALY CLOSE). In this position P.L.C gets a positive input and trip off the power to the unwinding motor. When the machine is in running position the machine pulls the laminate from the unwinding assembly along with the dancing roller. Because of NO connection of the limit switch, the gear motor which is fitted in the unwinding assembly with the rubber roller is induced to run by the P.L.C.

Within this longitudinal sealing station longitudinal pouch seams are produced. The sealing tools are individually heated and adjusted accordingly. Vertical sealing unit basically consists of two different sub-units, one is Front sealing unit (Bend arm side) & other, Rear sealing unit (Machine side) Sealing task happens when both these units will move towards each other and pressuring the laminate in between. The rear sealing jaws are guided in shaft fixed position on a common machine side carrier plate. The front sealing jaws (3) are mounted to a Bend arm side (1) carrier plate and individually adjustable according to the pouch size, the crank shaft will rotate such that the carrier plate is moved to its working position (0.5mm -lmm offset from the funnel center axis towards machine). Complete bend-arm unit can be adjusted forward and backward, by adjusting crank shaft movement. The rear sealing jaw (2) movement will be implemented bya crank shaft. This crank shaft will translate whole rear carrier plate such that distance between sealing profile and the base plate reaches 210mm as shown in fig. above. Since front sealing profile is offset from the center axis, this will cause movement of crank shaft. Larger the degree movement of crank shaft greater will be the sealing pressure. Ltd 9.1 FILTER/REGULATOR UNIT The operational reliability and service life of a pneumatic system depend to a large extent on quality of compressed air. Impurities in compressed air such as scale, rust and dust as well as moisture and oil constituents in air which deposit as condensate can cause a great deal of damage in pneumatic systems. These contaminants accelerate wear on sliding surfaces and sealing elements, adversely affecting the functioning and service life of pneumatic components. As a result of switching the compressors ON and OFF, pressure fluctuations occur which have an unfavourable effect on the functioning of the system. In order to eliminate these effects, compressed air service limits must be installed in every pneumatic control. Function of Service Units: Compressed air filters remove solid particles and moisture droplets from the supply air. Particles, which are larger than 404m (depending on filter element), are retained by a sintered filter. Liquids are separated into the filter bowl by means of a special device.

Ltd 13.1 MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE Keeping the machine clean is one of the important things to be followed by the customer as the part of machine maintenance. Since the machine consists of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and electronic parts and sub assemblies, it would be difficult to adopt one single means of cleaning for whole machine. Suitable cleaning methods should therefore be followed. Assembly wise recommended cleaning methods for machine have been briefed below. Before starting the cleaning activity, switch off electrical power supply to machine. MACHINE TOP CLEANING: Machine top can be cleaned with Wet cloth; vacuum cleaner can be use for cleaning accumulated foreign particles in corners, crevices and surfaces of the top area of machine. A. Clean the “* Product deposited areas on machine top or parts on Gripper turret, “* Product Filling Station and product discharge route, “* Discharge Conveyor, “* Puller Rollers (Take care the water does not gone inside the machine), “* Serrations of Sealing jaw - use a wire brush to clean the dirt on the serrations, “* And the whole machine top — If possible this cleaning is to be done every day after production. “* Please open the machine guards (stainless steel) at lower part of M/C. & clean the inside surface at the end of each shift for spillage of oil from Auto lubrication system if any. “* For cleaning and maintenance of parts above human height. Please use ladder with platform & safety railing so that person can safely clean the machine parts which are beyond the reach of human height. “* For change over of pouch width please switch-off the heater switch & than setting of pouch width are to be done only after all the heater reaches an ambient temperature. During water cleaning please do not remove any guard or housing from the machine. Water should not go inside the Gunmetal bushes or housings. Ltd 9.1 FILTER/REGULATOR UNIT The operational reliability and service life of a pneumatic system depend to a large extent on quality of compressed air. Impurities in compressed air such as scale, rust and dust as well as moisture and oil constituents in air which deposit as condensate can cause a great deal of damage in pneumatic systems. These contaminants accelerate wear on sliding surfaces and sealing elements, adversely affecting the functioning and service life of pneumatic components. As a result of switching the compressors ON and OFF, pressure fluctuations occur which have an unfavourable effect on the functioning of the system. In order to eliminate these effects, compressed air service limits must be installed in every pneumatic control. Function of Service Units: Compressed air filters remove solid particles and moisture droplets from the supply air. Particles, which are larger than 404m (depending on filter element), are retained by a sintered filter. Liquids are separated into the filter bowl by means of a special device.

The condensate collecting in the filter bowl is drained from time to time as otherwise it would be entrained by the air. The regulator keeps the working pressure (secondary side) largely constant, irrespective of pressure fluctuations in the supply system (primary side) and the air consumption. The inlet pressure must always be higher than the working pressure. The task of lubricator is to supply pneumatic components with an adequate amount of lubricant. Using the Ventury principle oil is sucked out of the reservoir and is atomised by coming into contact with the flowing air. Within this longitudinal sealing station longitudinal pouch seams are produced. The sealing tools are individually heated and adjusted accordingly. Vertical sealing unit basically consists of two different sub-units, one is Front sealing unit (Bend arm side) & other, Rear sealing unit (Machine side) Sealing task happens when both these units will move towards each other and pressuring the laminate in between. The rear sealing jaws are guided in shaft fixed position on a common machine side carrier plate. The front sealing jaws (3) are mounted to a Bend arm side (1) carrier plate and individually adjustable according to the pouch size, the crank shaft will rotate such that the carrier plate is moved to its working position (0.5mm -lmm offset from the funnel center axis towards machine). Complete bend-arm unit can be adjusted forward and backward, by adjusting crank shaft movement. The rear sealing jaw (2) movement will be implemented bya crank shaft. This crank shaft will translate whole rear carrier plate such that distance between sealing profile and the base plate reaches 210mm as shown in fig. above. Since front sealing profile is offset from the center axis, this will cause movement of crank shaft. Larger the degree movement of crank shaft greater will be the sealing pressure. So pressure on vertical sealers critically depends upon this offset distance from funnel center axis.
